description: Authoritative institutional knowledge sources, agricultural research compendia, and regulatory pesticide registers for AgroVision AI 2.0.

sources.title: PJTSAU Vyavasaya Panchangam (Agronomic Package of Practices for Field and Horticultural Crops)
sources.organization: Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University (PJTSAU), Hyderabad
sources.knowledge_claim_supported: Official crop-specific disease diagnostic milestones, symptom descriptions, and recommended IPM management packages for Telangana agro-climatic zones.

sources.title: ANGRAU Crop Protection Guide and Disease Diagnostic Field Compendium
sources.organization: Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU), Guntur, Andhra Pradesh
sources.knowledge_claim_supported: Pathogen biology, look-alike field differentiators, foliar diagnostic keys, and integrated management for coastal and Rayalaseema agricultural zones.

sources.title: ICAR National Integrated Pest Management Packages for Major Horticultural Crops
sources.organization: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) - NCIPM, New Delhi
sources.knowledge_claim_supported: Bio-control agents (Trichoderma viride, Pseudomonas fluorescens, Bacillus subtilis), cultural sanitation, and economic threshold levels (ETL).

sources.title: ICAR-IIRR Rice Diseases Compendium and Eco-Friendly Management Guidelines
sources.organization: ICAR - Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR), Rajendranagar, Hyderabad
sources.knowledge_claim_supported: Differential diagnostic keys for Rice Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae) vs Brown Spot (Bipolaris oryzae) vs Bacterial Leaf Blight (Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae).

sources.title: Major Uses of Pesticides Registered Under the Insecticides Act, 1968
sources.organization: Central Insecticides Board and Registration Committee (CIBRC), Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine & Storage, Ministry of Agriculture, Govt. of India
sources.knowledge_claim_supported: Approved active ingredients, formulation types, statutory crop-target combinations, dilution rates, and pre-harvest intervals (PHI).

sources.title: CABI PlantwisePlus Knowledge Bank: Pest and Disease Management Decision Guides
sources.organization: Centre for Agriculture and Bioscience International (CABI), Wallingford, UK
sources.knowledge_claim_supported: Global symptom ontology, pathogen etiology, secondary spread dynamics, and cultural prevention measures for tropical and subtropical crops.

sources.title: ICAR-CICR Cotton Disease Diagnosis and Integrated Disease Management Manual
sources.organization: ICAR - Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR), Nagpur
sources.knowledge_claim_supported: Cotton Bacterial Blight (Xanthomonas citri pv. malvacearum), Alternaria Leaf Spot, and Fusarium Wilt diagnostic criteria and weather-based risk warnings.
